issue_context.title: Can i pull code adding a new api to remove all the cert and pkey from ssl_ctx?
issue_context.body: I just want a api can help me do the remove operation when i set much cert to the ssl_ctx and i don't want their anymore.
comments:
Typically one would just make a new `SSL_CTX` with the desired configuration in such a scenario.
Note that it is unsupported to modify the configuration of an `SSL_CTX` once there are any `SSL` objects associated with it, for thread-safety purposes.
